aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.blurb: The current look: a colour for every page, soft glow, glass bars.

liquid-morph.name: Liquid Morph
liquid-morph.blurb: Soft blobs that melt into each other, pill shapes, springy hovers.

3d-spatial.name: 3D Spatial
3d-spatial.blurb: Everything floats above the page on its own layer and tilts towards you.

holographic.name: Holographic
holographic.blurb: Iridescent foil: colours that shift as the light moves across them.

cyberpunk-neon.name: Cyberpunk Neon
cyberpunk-neon.blurb: Black glass, neon yellow, cut corners, a little glitch.

wireframe-3d.name: Wireframe 3D
wireframe-3d.blurb: Everything is an outline: edges only, with a grid floor receding into the distance.

retro-vhs.name: Retro VHS
retro-vhs.blurb: A tape from 1994: scanlines, colour fringes, a tracking glitch.

minimal-editorial.name: Minimal Editorial
minimal-editorial.blurb: A printed page: serif headlines, hairlines, one ink colour, lots of air.

clay-3d.name: Clay 3D
clay-3d.blurb: Soft, chunky and pastel, as if everything was pressed from modelling clay.

blueprint.name: Blueprint
blueprint.blurb: White lines on drawing-paper blue: grid, dashes and labelled dimensions.

ascii-terminal.name: ASCII Terminal
ascii-terminal.blurb: Green phosphor on black, monospace everywhere, brackets around the buttons.
